row: If you could find out why your body isn't functioning as it should, wouldn't you? At Dynamic Spine and Sports Therapy our focus is to get you back to your sport, your life, your best! Our top priority is to get you moving again, by using sports medicine that focuses on the entire body to treat the cause, not the symptoms, and prevent your condition from returning.
